missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Склад' stays in the nominative case as the masculine subject standing behind the house. 'Большой' is the agreeing masculine adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Склад' is the accusative direct object of 'построили'; this inanimate masculine noun matches its nominative form. 'Новый' agrees in the masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'На складе' uses the prepositional form 'складе' after 'на' to show where the goods are kept. A common storage expression.
Strategic focus: Genitive of source. 'Со склада' uses the genitive form 'склада' after 'со' to express leaving the warehouse. The preposition 'с' governs the genitive of departure.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'На склад' uses the accusative after 'на' to show motion toward the warehouse. The inanimate form matches the nominative.
Strategic focus: Dative with preposition. 'К складу' uses the dative form 'складу' after 'к' marking the goal the road leads to. 'Новому' agrees in the masculine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental object. 'Складом' is the instrumental case required by the verb 'управлять'. 'Огромным' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Складов' is the genitive plural required after 'много'. 'Больших' agrees in the genitive plural. A core counting pattern.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Склады' is the nominative plural subject standing beyond the river. 'Старые' is the agreeing plural adjective.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Склад' is nominative as the subject. 'Пустой' is the agreeing masculine predicate adjective, intensified by 'совсем'. A clean descriptive model.
